blocks.text: NASHVILLE, Tennessee — Cam Boozer finds himself in an unfamiliar space as he embarks on the NBA career he has prepared for his entire life. He’s on his own. Sure, father Carlos, a two-time NBA All-Star and 13-year veteran, is just a phone call or text away. The biggest difference on the court and in daily life is twin brother Cayden isn’t in Memphis with him. Cadyn stayed in college at Duke when Cam decided to enter the NBA draft.
